title: Dual Transformers With Latent Amplification for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
method_summary: 双 Transformer 的潜变量放大增强正常与异常的表示差异，结合异常评分进行多变量检测。
reproduction_gap: MRH、双编码器、注意力熵、scaled-softmax及fit/score和显式消融已还原；未公开架构/归约/验证搜索细节待核。

anchors.review: curated synopsis; marker verified in extracted text; not a full-page manual review

configuration.score_contract: finite [B,T,C] preprocessed grouped windows -> [B,T] continuous scores; evaluator handles overlap/threshold/PA
configuration.benchmark_acceptance: not_run; CPU behavioral checks do not establish paper performance

ablations.delta: supported positive parameter; validation-only grid not frozen in paper text

assumptions: Paper defines attention map L x L but also calls it sensor attention; implement temporal token attention per Eq7/8.
Input and latent loss use squared channel sum then average batch/time. Entropy sums query/key axes and averages heads/layers/batch; paper does not fix these multihead reductions.
Secondary encoder has independent input embedding; exact embedding/position architecture unspecified.
delta=1.0 is a runnable placeholder, not a reported dataset optimum.
100 epochs configured; early stopping/validation search belong to runner and are not implemented in this detector.
Published MRH is discontinuous at delta when delta != 1; formula preserved, not silently smoothed.
